note: Evidence-gathering only; NOT a promotion and NOT a qualification pass. Records that the section-10 Gate-1 and Gate-2 tooling is cryptographically pinned to the retained pancake checkpoint and cannot be executed on the Lineage B checkpoint as written.

gate_1.name: exact canonical-successor execution + backbone qualification
gate_1.error: ValueError: checkpoint is not the retained step-6250 pancake
gate_1.blocker_reason: Script raises unless file_sha256(--checkpoint) == RETAINED_PANCAKE_CHECKPOINT_SHA256 (griddd_conditional.py:74). B's SHA differs; the guard fires before any qualification math runs. The default --panel (artifacts/canonical_successor_backbone_qualification/panel_manifest.json) also binds the pancake SHA (checkpoint_sha256=47716924...), and line 76 requires panel.checkpoint_sha256 == checkpoint_sha256, so B has no bound panel either.

gate_2.name: zero-sidecar equivalence to the unconditional law
gate_2.error: ValueError: qualified unconditional checkpoint hash mismatch: expected 47716924f7798ed24556c5aa8fb10c533c55dbd1f02f8f53a463cf2ad80ae2bf, observed c9d927510360ec6eb84ff8dae1a222b0b693a9bef0ca23bb5d9cca063025876c
gate_2.blocker_reason: Gate 2 requires a Gate-1 qualification manifest whose bound checkpoint SHA equals the --checkpoint SHA. The only loadable analytic manifest binds the pancake SHA. A B-bound analytic manifest is not loadable because load_unconditional_backbone_qualification -> from_payload requires checkpoint_sha256 == RETAINED_PANCAKE for ANALYTIC format (griddd_conditional.py:215). A native (BACKBONE_QUALIFICATION_FORMAT) manifest binding B's SHA would load, but Gate 2 then crashes at run_griddd_analytic_zero_sidecar_smoke.py:135 with float(qualification.small_ring_log_rate_adjustment)=float(None) because native manifests leave calibration fields None; and no script produces such a native manifest for B's exact checkpoint.

intended_assertion_if_reachable.equality_tolerance: EXACT (== 0.0) on target-vs-base family-rate abs error, missing-vs-base family-rate abs error, target-vs-base total-hazard abs error, and max abs family log-hazard residual (run_griddd_analytic_zero_sidecar_smoke.py:209-218)

small_ring_log_rate_adjustment.enters_gate1_only_as: hardcoded requirement on --rollout profile (qualify_analytic_pancake_quotient_backbone.py:212-213) and hardcoded output block (238-240)

calibration_wiring.zero_calibration_reason: For ANALYTIC_BACKBONE_QUALIFICATION_FORMAT the loader from_payload hard-requires atom_delete==-0.5 AND small_ring==-1.5 (griddd_conditional.py:237-238, raising 'analytic qualification changed the passed calibration') and small_ring_maximum_size==4 (line 239-240). Gate-1 script exposes no calibration knob and always writes -0.5/-1.5. There is no code path to qualify any checkpoint as an analytic conditional base with zero calibration.
calibration_wiring.no_escape_hatch: No environ/getenv/override/allow-bypass flag exists in either gate script or in the qualification loader for the SHA pin or the calibration pin.

reasons: Emits weight_source 'step6250_pancake_plus_panel_quotient_distilled_family_hazard_heads', which is NOT in the loader's allowed set {pancake_derived, canonical_successor_native} (griddd_conditional.py:174), so its manifest cannot feed Gate 2.

It distills/trains new family-hazard heads and mints a NEW qualified checkpoint (a different SHA), i.e. it does not qualify B's exact verified checkpoint c9d927...; task forbids using any file other than B's checkpoint.

conclusion.gate_1: FAIL — cannot execute on B (cryptographic pancake-SHA pin).
conclusion.gate_2: FAIL — cannot execute on B (qualification/checkpoint SHA-mismatch; and the analytic manifest B would need is unloadable).
conclusion.lineage_b_qualifiable_as_conditional_bas: NOT DETERMINABLE with current tooling — the §10 Gate-1/Gate-2 scripts are pinned to the pancake checkpoint AND to the exact -0.5/-1.5 calibration; a zero-calibration qualification is not expressible. Answering the scientific question requires a tooling change (generalize the SHA pin to bind B, and make calibration a declared+verified parameter rather than a hardcoded -0.5/-1.5), which is code work, not evidence gathering, and was not performed here.
conclusion.gates_3_4_5_contrast: Gates 3/4/5 could be gathered for B (diagnostics/griddd_valid_fiber_controller_panel12_lineageB_ceiling.json) because scripts/griddd_valid_fiber_controller_panel.py has NO SHA guard and accepts any --checkpoint. Gates 1/2 differ: their scripts (and the shared qualification loader) hard-pin the pancake SHA and calibration.
